definitions.rationale: This equation defines the base case of the oddAcc accumulator summary on an empty integer sequence.
This recurrence defines oddAcc on an even head by preserving the accumulator and recursing on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule oddAcc(A:Int, iCons(I:Int, R:IntSeq)) => oddAcc(A, R)
    requires pyMod(I, 2) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: This recurrence defines oddAcc on an odd head by incrementing the accumulator and recursing on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule oddAcc(A:Int, iCons(I:Int, R:IntSeq)) => oddAcc(A +Int 1, R)
    requires pyMod(I, 2) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the base case of the evenAcc accumulator summary on an empty integer sequence.
This recurrence defines evenAcc on an even head by incrementing the accumulator and recursing on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule evenAcc(A:Int, iCons(I:Int, R:IntSeq)) => evenAcc(A +Int 1, R)
    requires pyMod(I, 2) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: This recurrence defines evenAcc on an odd head by preserving the accumulator and recursing on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule evenAcc(A:Int, iCons(I:Int, R:IntSeq)) => evenAcc(A, R)
    requires pyMod(I, 2) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This conditional equation defines exchangeResult as the encoded string YES when the odd-count summary does not exceed the even-count summary.
definitions.text:
rule exchangeResult(A:IntSeq, B:IntSeq)
    => str(iCons(89, iCons(69, iCons(83, .IntSeq))))
    requires oddAcc(0, A) <=Int evenAcc(0, B)

definitions.rationale: This complementary conditional equation defines exchangeResult as the encoded string NO when the odd-count summary exceeds the even-count summary.
definitions.text:
rule exchangeResult(A:IntSeq, B:IntSeq)
    => str(iCons(78, iCons(79, .IntSeq)))
    requires oddAcc(0, A) >Int evenAcc(0, B)

definitions.rationale: This macro rule defines the named ODD-BODY proof term by expanding it to the first loop's exact translated statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule ODD-BODY
    => If(
         Compare(BinOp("%", Name("number"), Int(2)),
                 CmpOp("!=", Int(0))),
         AugAssign(Name("odd"), "+", Int(1)),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: This macro rule defines the named EVEN-BODY proof term by expanding it to the second loop's exact translated statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule EVEN-BODY
    => If(
         Compare(BinOp("%", Name("number"), Int(2)),
                 CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
         AugAssign(Name("even"), "+", Int(1)),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: This macro rule defines exchangeDef as the exact constructor-level function body used by the end-to-end proof claim.
definitions.text:
rule exchangeDef
    => FuncDef(
         "exchange",
         Params("lst1", "lst2"),
         Assign(Name("odd"), Int(0))
         Assign(Name("even"), Int(0))
         Assign(Name("number"), Int(0))
         For(Name("number"), Name("lst1"), ODD-BODY)
         For(Name("number"), Name("lst2"), EVEN-BODY)
         If(Compare(Name("odd"), CmpOp("<=", Name("even"))),
            Return(Str("YES")),
            .Stmts)
         Return(Str("NO")))

operational_rules.rationale: This is the empty-case iterator transition for the verification model's typed intVals list representation; it specifies execution behavior rather than asserting an additional mathematical fact.
This is the nonempty-case iterator transition for intVals, yielding the head integer and continuing with the tail as ordinary verification-model execution behavior.
